title: Observability
description: IT domain composite for Observability, materializing its applicable cross-framework facets. Typing: extends Observability (rootless — qualifier/data roles only). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties. Mount-key distinctness within one composite is the author's responsibility now that titles are no longer framework-prefixed). Mounted facets — attributed-to: Attribution; measured-by-product-quality: ProductAvailability, ProductCompatibility, ProductFunctionalSuitability, ProductInteroperability, ProductMaintainability, ProductPerformanceEfficiency, ProductPortability, ProductReliability, ProductScalability, ProductSecurity, ProductUsability. Source: hand-authored, TOGAF technology-architecture stratum.
